name: voracious_greatshark_counters_a_creature_spell
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Flash. When this creature enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.' On seat 1's turn seat 1 casts Llanowar Elves and holds priority; in response seat 0 flashes in Voracious Greatshark, whose trigger counters the Elves: they go to seat 1's graveyard. (Both pools are filled before the Elves are cast: a mana step passes priority.)
